Is it difficult to transfer them to a potting mix if you use an aeroponic cloner?

Not at all. You just take the rooted clone out of the cloner when the roots get to like 15-18cm and sort of lay the roots gently on the soil, then cover them with more soil. Takes all of 30 seconds. Plus you get to see the roots forming, so you know how well each clone is doing. I take them from the aerocloner and put them in solo cups for 2 weeks, then 1g, then 5g pots.

The Crop King site says that they only have low to moderate THC content though, I guess we'll have to see.

Yeah, that's the Ruderalis genetics. In order to get them to autoflower as opposed to photoperiod, they breed good weed (Indica or Sativa) with Ruderalis plants that have the auto trait. The problem is that Ruderalis plants have barely any cannabinoids. So say you have [Strain] and it has 22% THC, and you want to make [Auto-Strain], the auto will be weaker, since one parent was 22%, and the other was like 3%. The weed will still get you high, but it will be more like middle shelf than top shelf. They are easier to grow though, so a lot of people think it's worth it. I personally clone extensively, so they aren't an option for me even if they had more THC. I grew well over 300 clones off my current Sour Diesel mother. Not bad for an $8 seed.
